gallery_portfolio_p1: Each work is unique, a work that aligns the artist's talent with the underwater world. The proposal of an uncertain future, a vision of human degeneration, a concern that his art highlights.
gallery_dive_in_p1: These paintings together form the extension of his thought; they coexist and together produce El Bachir's project.
gallery_dive_in_p2: Our fins reappear, our breath is cut short, our body finds the oxygen of water.

about_page_origins_text: is an artist from Senegal who throughout the years developed and maintaine a unique style and technique
about_page_origins_text_bold: devoted to sacralize the presence of art in our contemporary world.
about_page_origins_text_sequel: Upon his arrival in Montreal, he established his studio at the Clark Center, where he defined the features of his current style—a redefinition of both himself and his art.
about_page_inspiration_text: He innovates by challenging the place of humans in our society and exploring how they will evolve in the centuries to come. In other words,
about_page_inspiration_text_bold: to challenge the prospects of our future.
about_page_inspiration_text_sequel: a close interplay between evolution and regression.
about_page_bachir_world_begin: Bachir a créé une histoire d’un peuple qui avait une pirogue en commun avec lequelle il partait à la chasse tous les jours pour la pêche était fleurissante, c’était bien, jusqu’au jour où, par mauvaise conduite du capitaine décida de partager le butin en pleine mer. En se chamaillant le butin, en se disputant, le bateau a chaviré, on est entré dans le monde de d’El-Bachir
